notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680952/4d6c8090facfbf4c0096246199094e55d9e0a68d.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.0.2 is already released![/h1]
-Lot of optimizations has been done, on some PC's you might see up to 20-50% performance increase.
-New animations (Bobby and Darius).
-Improved lighting and visual quality in some scenes.
-Fixed lot of bugs.
-Lot of small details like face scanner in elevator or new texture for Bobby model.
-New teleport animations and improvements

notes.title: Milestones in Trello
notes.notes:
Many thanks for your generous feedback. We collected all the critique and assembled into this Trello board. We will finish everything at the end of January. Please feel free to add your thoughts and comments on this.  

[url=https://trello.com/b/fZJGqLVs/kamile-ea][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680952/e2f3c2fa3b1f94eb91d30e7c5577dc5d77074b58.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://trello.com/b/fZJGqLVs/kamile-ea]https://trello.com/b/fZJGqLVs/kamile-ea[/url]

In terms of core gameplay/story, we have three big goals:

+ First, we need to improve and create more realistic character animations and textures. 
+ Second, we will polish all those small but yummy details you'll find in Trello.
+ Finally, we will optimize everything for Quest. 

Thanks,
Bartosh & Kamile team.

P.S. Don't forget to review [b]Kamile[/b] and follow the Twitter updates.

♥

101 everyone! First hot-fix update is here (you know how it happens after the release)

Version 1.0.1

- Fixed some sound bugs.

Enjoy the experience! If you will find more bugs - you can write to us via steam or discord. ːsteamhappyː
